description: This Java class 'ThingEventAdapter' acts as an adapter for mapping 'ThingEvent' objects to and from 'Adaptable' representations within the Eclipse Ditto protocol framework. It contains methods for creating new adapter instances and mapping 'ThingEvent' signals to 'Adaptable' objects with appropriate topic paths, payloads, and headers.

classes.name: ThingEventAdapter
classes.description: Final class that extends 'AbstractThingAdapter' and implements 'EventAdapter' to facilitate mapping between 'ThingEvent' instances and 'Adaptable' representations for Eclipse Ditto protocol integration.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new 'ThingEventAdapter' instance given a 'HeaderTranslator'.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Overrides the method to determine the type string based on the 'Adaptable' object's topic path and payload.

methods.name: mapSignalToAdaptable
methods.description: Converts a 'ThingEvent' into an 'Adaptable' object with appropriate topic path, payload, and headers based on the event data and the specified channel.

methods.name: getActionNameWithFirstLetterUpperCase
methods.description: Private static method to retrieve and capitalize the action name from a 'TopicPath'.
